name: Hotel Resch
beschreibung: Hotel Resch is ideally positioned in the heart of world-famous Kitzbühel. The family-operated hotel combines genuine Tyrolean warmth with contemporary comfort. The legendary Hahnenkamm cable car and KitzSki slopes are just a short walk away, alongside scenic summer hiking and biking trails throughout the Kitzbühel Alps. Amenities include comfortable alpine rooms, a relaxing sauna area, and a traditional restaurant serving regional classics.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Resch in central Kitzbühel offers cozy alpine rooms, a sauna area, authentic Tyrolean dining, and walking distance to the famous Hahnenkamm cable car.
